submission.bindingBasis: The owner reports ownerChanged=true and source identity advanced after planning. The planning-time evidence (sourceStateDigest sha256:e5d8...62ce64) may no longer be current. Per the owner action contract, workspace.close may compare-and-close one exact expectedSourceStateDigest, and a mismatch fails not_committed. Since the workspace source advanced, the close could either fail (mismatch) or close unbound. I need to re-observe the current sourceStateDigest and headRevision before deciding how to bind the close.
submission.rationale: The owner reported ownerChanged=true and that workspace source identity advanced after planning. This invalidates the planning-time sourceStateDigest and head revision. Per the owner action contract, workspace.close may compare-and-close against one exact expectedSourceStateDigest, and a mismatch fails not_committed. Acting now with the stale planning binding risks a conflict (mismatch → not_committed), and acting unbound would close without the intended commit-level guarantee. The correct path is to re-observe (workspace.get) to capture current headRevision and exact sourceStateDigest, then decide how to bind the close.
